description: Compare two versions of a bill's text (GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}/diff): a unified diff plus similarity, added/removed line and character counts, and changed-section highlights. Get the two version ids from get_bill with include:['texts'] — each text row's `text_id`. Pass them as `from` (the earlier version) and `to` (the later version). Diffs are precomputed, so only bills that have more than one text version return one.

bill_id.description: bill_id the two texts belong to.

from.description: Text-version id of the earlier version (the baseline).

to.description: Text-version id of the later version to compare against.

name: get_bill_diff
title: Diff two bill-text versions
